name: Tokimeite Yuuwaku
source:
Usagi Chihiro is a female teacher who has just transferred. All the students and teachers at school can't take their eyes of her. But she actually enjoys those look and behaves in provocative manner.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/08/vn-of-month-april-1997.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
兔千寻是一位刚转来的女老师。学校里所有的学生和老师都无法将目光从她身上移开。但她其实很享受这些目光，并以挑逗的方式行事。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/08/vn-of-month-april-1997.html]vndbreview[/url]]
